segment.source: Renders a set of destinations as a grid of cards, each with an icon, its title and a line explaining what is behind it. Use it for: the landing page of a section, a service overview, a topic hub, the entry point into a documentation area, a choice between four or five routes. Prefer 'Page List Menu' when there are more than a dozen destinations, and 'Link Grid' when the titles alone say enough without a card around them.
